objective: Supported declared dependency manifests or lockfiles inside the assessed repository scope must not contain dependencies matched to known published vulnerabilities by the qualified provider.
applies_to: Git repositories with explicitly declared supported dependency metadata
required_evidence: Readable provider assessment covering every declared inventory entry, bound to target and Git HEAD

status_semantics.PASS: Reliable assessment of declared inventory; zero matched known vulnerabilities.
status_semantics.FAIL: Reliable assessment; one or more matched known vulnerabilities.
status_semantics.BLOCKED: Provider unavailable, identity/version mismatch, network or execution failure, unreliable inventory or malformed/indeterminate output.

limitations: Other formats, unpinned requirements, includes, URLs, markers and automatic transitive resolution are not qualified in this slice.
Network-dependent OSV data at assessment time; unknown vulnerabilities and runtime exploitability not assessed.
Checksum fetched from official HTTPS release; not independent publisher signature verification.
